raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "stay at"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "a hotel near the beach"
  role location "Băile Felix"
  role time "last year"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "be named"
  role subject "the hotel"
  role object "Lotus or Lotus Therm"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty hedged

@s3 stated
  relation "cost"
  role subject "a night with breakfast"
  role object "450 lei"
  role location "the hotel"
  role time "last year"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@a1 assumed
  relation "increase in price"
  role subject "accommodations"
  role location "Băile Felix"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@q query
  select ?p
  where match
    relation "cost"
    role subject "a night with breakfast"
    role object ?p
    role location "Lotus or Lotus Therm"
    role location "Băile Felix"
    polarity affirmed
    at "now"
  end
